narrative.overview: User-approved continuous mural spans the scrolling homepage over a pink-to-lilac-to-peach-to-rose gradient. Transparent generated floral vine tiles join vertically with alternating mirroring. Section and footer backgrounds are transparent; airbrush uses dark ink over lavender and the footer continues the rose surface. Selected hero, header, layout, and layered photography remain unchanged.
keyCharacteristics: Preserved selected hero and compact header
Layered supplied photography and warm frames
dos: Preserve selected hero, header, and layout.
Keep the mural continuous across transparent homepage sections.
Retain supplied layered photos and warm frames.
Keep dark ink readable over lavender and rose surfaces.
Keep sample email and preview-only form explicit.
donts: Do not restore hard section background edges on home.
Do not restore superseded plum airbrush or dark footer on home.
Do not send contact form data.
Do not alter supplied image originals.
Do not treat historical alternatives as current authority.
